node.title: Re^2: Installing Curses module under Win32
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Note the post you're replying to is 11 years old and the Monk you're writing to was last seen at that time as well. You'll probably have more luck posting a new question in [href://?node_id=479#post|SoPW] and following the guidelines in [id://174051], that is, showing some short example code that you're having problems with so that people wanting to help can try and reproduce the issue for themselves. Also, if you're having trouble installing [mod://Curses::UI], perhaps show the error messages from the build (with enough context) - [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=Curses-UI|CPAN Testers] appears to show that the module has built successfully on Win32 in the past.
